narration: Why does gold often rise when markets panic? Gold is one of the five commodities you can trade on Meme Street. In the real world, it's been a store of value for thousands of years. Demand comes from investors looking for a safe haven, jewellery buyers, and central banks holding it in reserve. When fear rises, many investors buy gold as a place to hide in rough times. Unlike a company, gold has no earnings and no boss. Its price is supply and demand. What can push it down? Rising interest rates, calm and confident markets, and big supply news. On Meme Street, data and headlines hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Trade gold at memestreet.net.
